news.title: Crizac agrees Inova deal to expand Mexican, European reach
news.summary_en: The student recruitment platform will strengthen its presence in Mexico and enter the Netherlands as a destination market through the proposed acquisition.
news.author: Abhishek Nair

news.title: Sudanese students to appeal after UK court upholds visa brake
news.summary_en: Sudan Scholars UK says students with full scholarships at Oxford, Cambridge, Imperial and UCL are unable to begin master’s courses in September and will pursue an appeal.
news.author: Abhishek Nair

news.title: New visa limits threaten US college revenues
news.summary_en: Global credit rating agency Fitch Ratings has joined growing warnings over the financial burden of replacing duration of status with fixed visa time limits.
news.author: Polly Nash

news.title: Four in five Indian study-abroad aspirants plan to return home
news.summary_en: Oxford International’s latest mobility survey reveals a more independent, first-generation cohort pursuing postgraduate education overseas, as rising costs, tighter immigration policies and expanding opportunities at home reshape Indian student ambitions.
news.author: Abhishek Nair

news.title: France increases proof of funds for study visas by 43%
news.summary_en: Students applying for a French long-stay student visa will now have to show they have at least €877.50 per month – up from the previous monthly threshold of €615.
news.author: Beth Kennedy

news.title: US faces $3.4bn hit as international enrolments fall
news.summary_en: Anticipated drops in international student numbers this fall are expected to cost the US $3.4bn in economic impact and 39,000 jobs, new analysis has revealed.
news.author: Polly Nash

news.title: RMIT Vietnam secures approval for new Hanoi campus and Saigon South expansion
news.summary_en: RMIT University has secured Vietnamese government approval to expand its operations in Vietnam, including plans for a new campus in Hanoi and the redevelopment of its existing Saigon South campus in Ho Chi Minh City.
news.author: Kim Martin

news.title: Marie Taillard, ESCP Business School
news.summary_en: This week, The PIE sat down with Professor Marie Taillard, UK dean of ESCP Business School. We spoke about her addiction to tea, how education is shaping the job market and the drive needed to succeed in the sector.
news.author: The PIE News team

news.title: Brazilian college counselling body launches to professionalise international guidance
news.summary_en: A new  Brazilian professional association for college counsellors and international admissions professionals has launched.
news.author: Beth Kennedy

news.title: 5 things we learned about multi-university campuses and TNE at The PIE Live Asia Pacific
news.summary_en: Multi-university campus models are moving from concept to reality in Asia and TNE provision continues to grow, but panelists at The PIE Live Asia Pacific warned that some providers are entering new markets for the wrong reasons.
news.author: Kim Martin

news.title: Can a British education be reimagined for India? Inside Shrewsbury’s experiment
news.summary_en: Shrewsbury International School India's first Indian campus reflects a much bigger question facing Britain's independent schools: can their educational philosophies travel as successfully as their brands?
news.author: Abhishek Nair

news.title: What Resolution 71 means for Vietnam’s bilingual and private schools
news.summary_en: Vietnam's overhaul of education, known as Resolution 71, is reshaping the country's school system. Joshua James unpacks what's changed and what it all means.
news.author: Joshua James
